shortDescription: Manage an external Hyperledger Fabric ordering service node

options.name: api_authtype
options.description: C(basic) - Authenticate to the Fabric operations console using basic authentication. You must provide both a valid API key using I(api_key) and API secret using I(api_secret).

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The URL for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_key
options.description: The API key for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: The API secret for the Fabric operations console. Only required when I(api_authtype) is C(basic).

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: The timeout, in seconds, to use when interacting with the Fabric operations console.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the external ordering service node. Only required when I(state) is C(absent).

options.name: ordering_service_node
options.description: The definition of the external ordering service node. Only required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: state
options.description: C(absent) - An ordering service matching the specified name will be stopped and removed. C(present) - Asserts that an ordering service matching the specified name and configuration exists. If no ordering service matches the specified name, an ordering service will be created. If an ordering service matches the specified name but the configuration does not match, then the ordering service will be updated, if it can be.
